title.target: zhàn zài dìtú qián de rén
title.english: People in Front of the Map

pairs.target: kāimén kàn zhǎn de zǎoshàng , yīwén hái zài láng xià miáo zuìhòu yìháng zì .
pairs.english: On the morning the exhibition opened, Iven was still lettering the last line in the corridor.
pairs.hanzi: 开门看展的早上，伊文还在廊下描最后一行字。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi tì tā ná zhemò dié , bùgǎn zhàn tài jìn .
pairs.english: Tavi held the ink dish for him, not daring to stand too close.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维替他拿着墨碟，不敢站太近。

pairs.target: zuótiān yīwén ràng rén pèng le yíxià gēbo , " lùlù " de lù zì duōchū bàntiáo tuǐ , guā le zhòngxiě , dào xiànzài zhǐmiàn réng kàndéchū yíkuài qiǎn hén .
pairs.english: Yesterday someone had bumped Iven’s arm, giving the character for “road” in “land route” half an extra leg; even after scraping and rewriting, a pale mark still showed on the paper.
pairs.hanzi: 昨天伊文让人碰了一下胳膊，“陆路”的路字多出半条腿，刮了重写，到现在纸面仍看得出一块浅痕。

pairs.target: dà tú yǐjīng guà hǎo . lǎoshī kànguò tǎ wéi de cǎogǎo , méi ràng tā gěi cāi bùzhǔn de zhīliú liánxiàn , zhī liúxià nàduàn qīnzì zǒuguò de hémiàn xiǎo tú .
pairs.english: The large map was hung. After reviewing Tavi’s draft, the teacher had kept him from connecting uncertain tributaries, retaining only the small sketch of the river stretch he had travelled himself.
pairs.hanzi: 大图已经挂好。老师看过塔维的草稿，没让他给猜不准的支流连线，只留下那段亲自走过的河面小图。

pairs.target: nán chà de míngzì xiě zài pángbiān , zhùmíng cóng mài pén rén dí qīng kǒuzhōng tīng lái , fāngwèi wèijīng shícè .
pairs.english: Southbranch’s name was written beside it, identified as heard from the basin seller Diqing, its location unmeasured.
pairs.hanzi: 南汊的名字写在旁边，注明从卖盆人荻青口中听来，方位未经实测。

pairs.target: shí huán yě huà le , zhǐshì ànbiān yígè dàndànde hú , méiyǒu tí shàng " gǔqiáo ".
pairs.english: The stone ring was drawn too, only a faint arc on the bank, without the label “ancient bridge.”
pairs.hanzi: 石环也画了，只是岸边一个淡淡的弧，没有题上“古桥”。

pairs.target: wén qí cǎi zhe dèngzǐ tiáo guàshéng . tā xiàlái hòutuì yuǎn jǐbù , yāoqiú yīwén bǎ xiǎo tú xià de zì suōduǎn , lǐyóu shì rén zǒujìn mén , dìyīyǎn yīnggāi néng kànjiàn zhèngtí , ér búshì yídà duàn jiěshì wèishénme méi huà .
pairs.english: Wenqi stood on a stool adjusting the cord. Coming down, he stepped back and asked Iven to shorten the text under the sketch: people entering should first see the main title, rather than a long explanation of why things were missing.
pairs.hanzi: 闻祁踩着凳子调挂绳。他下来后退远几步，要求伊文把小图下的字缩短，理由是人走进门，第一眼应该能看见正题，而不是一大段解释为什么没画。

pairs.target: " yǐjīng duǎn guò yìhuí le . " yīwén shuō .
pairs.english: “It has already been shortened once,” Iven said.
pairs.hanzi: “已经短过一回了。”伊文说。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi duān zhemò dié , hūrán juéde zhè dié mò hěn bù fāngbiàn . shuí xiān shēnshǒu , tā dōu xiàng zài bāng shuí .
pairs.english: Holding the ink dish, Tavi suddenly found it awkward: whoever reached first, he seemed to be helping that person.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维端着墨碟，忽然觉得这碟墨很不方便。谁先伸手，他都像在帮谁。

pairs.target: tā gāng xiǎng wǎng zhuōshàng fàng , yīwén què jiēguò qù , shuō xiān guà , xiàwǔ kàn rén zhàn zài nǎlǐ , zài zhēng .
pairs.english: He was about to put it on the table when Iven took it, saying they should hang it first and argue again after seeing where people stood that afternoon.
pairs.hanzi: 他刚想往桌上放，伊文却接过去，说先挂，下午看人站在哪里，再争。

pairs.target: dìyī bō lái de shì xuéshēng jiālǐrén . yǒurén zhíbèn lǐmiàn zhǎo háizi de zuòpǐn , yǒurén zhàn zài ménkǒu kàn tú , zhǐzhe zìjǐ de láilù , shuō yuánlái nàduàn pō zài zhǐ shàng zhǐyǒu zhème yìdiǎn .
pairs.english: The first group were students’ families. Some went straight inside to find their children’s work; others studied the map at the entrance, pointing out their route and marveling that a whole slope took so little space on paper.
pairs.hanzi: 第一拨来的是学生家里人。有人直奔里面找孩子的作品，有人站在门口看图，指着自己的来路，说原来那段坡在纸上只有这么一点。

pairs.target: yígè bèi zhúlǒu de nǚrén tíng dé jiǔ xiē , dītóu kàn xiàfāng de xiǎo tú .
pairs.english: A woman carrying a bamboo basket lingered, looking down at the small sketch below.
pairs.hanzi: 一个背竹篓的女人停得久些，低头看下方的小图。

pairs.target: lǒu lǐ lùchū yíjuàn shàigān de cǎo jīng , tā bǎ lǒuzǐ wǎng pángbiān ràng le ràng , wèn tǎ wéi , nán chà nàbiān xiànzài shìbushì hái shōu dà kǒu de táopén .
pairs.english: A coil of dried grass stems showed from her basket. She shifted it aside and asked Tavi whether Southbranch still bought wide-mouthed pottery basins.
pairs.hanzi: 篓里露出一卷晒干的草茎，她把篓子往旁边让了让，问塔维，南汊那边现在是不是还收大口的陶盆。

pairs.target: tā yìshí dá bú shànglái , shuō zìjǐ zhǐjiàn guò mài pén de dí qīng . nǚrén tīngjiàn míngzì , xiǎng le yíxià , shuō bú rènshi , zìjǐ shì lái gěi zài xuégōng bāngchú de mèimei sòng cǎoshéng de .
pairs.english: He could not answer at once and said he had only met Diqing, who sold basins. Hearing the name, the woman thought a moment and said she did not know her; she was delivering grass rope to her younger sister, who helped in the academy kitchen.
pairs.hanzi: 他一时答不上来，说自己只见过卖盆的荻青。女人听见名字，想了一下，说不认识，自己是来给在学宫帮厨的妹妹送草绳的。

pairs.target: " wǒ cóng xiàyóu guòlái . wǒmen nàlǐ pén kǒu kuān de hǎo mài , dǐ tài shēn , bào zhe xǐ dōngxī fèijìn . "
pairs.english: “I came from downstream. Wide-rimmed basins sell well where we live; if the bottom is too deep, holding them while washing things is hard work.”
pairs.hanzi: “我从下游过来。我们那里盆口宽的好卖，底太深，抱着洗东西费劲。”

pairs.target: tā shuō zhe yòng liǎngshǒu bǐ le yígè yuán . tǎ wéi qǐng tā děngyīděng , jiào lái yīwén .
pairs.english: As she spoke, she shaped a circle with both hands. Tavi asked her to wait and called Iven over.
pairs.hanzi: 她说着用两手比了一个圆。塔维请她等一等，叫来伊文。

pairs.target: tā dǎo yǒudiǎn bùhǎoyìsi , xiān shuō zìjǐ méi zuò guò tāmen huà de zhè duàn chuán , bù xiǎode zhèlǐ de hé zhuǎn dé duì bu duì , zhǐshì kànjiàn pén , xiǎng wèn jiàqián .
pairs.english: A little embarrassed, she first said she had never taken the boat along their drawn stretch and did not know whether the river bends were right; she had only seen basins and wanted to ask the price.
pairs.hanzi: 她倒有点不好意思，先说自己没坐过他们画的这段船，不晓得这里的河转得对不对，只是看见盆，想问价钱。

alignment.english: whether the river bends were right

pairs.target: yīwén dītóu kàn tǎ wéi huà zài chuánbiān de jǐgè xiǎoquān , zuǐjiǎo chōu le yíxià . " zhè búshì pén . "
pairs.english: Iven looked down at the small circles Tavi had drawn along the boat, his mouth twitching. “Those are not basins.”
pairs.hanzi:
伊文低头看塔维画在船边的几个小圈，嘴角抽了一下。
“这不是盆。”

pairs.target: nǚrén còujìn kànkàn . tǎ wéi shuō zhè shì bǎng huò de shéng . tā yuán xiǎng bǎ chuán huà dé xiàng yìdiǎn , shéngquān dōu miáo zài cèmiàn , méixiǎngdào xiàng guà zhe yìpái pén .
pairs.english: The woman leaned closer. Tavi said it was cargo rope. He had meant to make the boat look more realistic by drawing coils along its side, never imagining they looked like hanging basins.
pairs.hanzi: 女人凑近看看。塔维说这是绑货的绳。他原想把船画得像一点，绳圈都描在侧面，没想到像挂着一排盆。

pairs.target: sāngè rén xiào qǐlái . wén qí zài lìngyìbiān jiào yīwén guòqù , shuō yǒurén zhǎo , yīwén yìng le , xiān bǎ zhuōshàng de kōng zhǐ dìgěi nǚrén , wèn tā yuànbuyuànyì huàhuà tā shuō de nàzhǒng pén .
pairs.english: All three laughed. Wenqi called Iven from the other side, saying someone wanted him. Iven answered, then first handed the woman blank paper from the table, asking if she would draw the kind of basin she meant.
pairs.hanzi: 三个人笑起来。闻祁在另一边叫伊文过去，说有人找，伊文应了，先把桌上的空纸递给女人，问她愿不愿意画画她说的那种盆。

pairs.target: tā shuō huà bùhǎo , shǒu què yǐjīng bǐ dào zhǐ shàng . zuìhòu háishì tǎ wéi tì tā huà , tā zhǐzhe dǐ shuō , zài qiǎn xiē , yòu jiāng pén kǒu liǎngbiān gètiān le yìxiǎo ěr .
pairs.english: She said she could not draw well, but her hands were already gesturing over the paper. In the end Tavi drew for her; she pointed to the bottom, saying shallower, then added a small lug to each side of the rim.
pairs.hanzi: 她说画不好，手却已经比到纸上。最后还是塔维替她画，她指着底说，再浅些，又将盆口两边各添了一小耳。

pairs.target: děng tā zǒujìn fàntīng zhǎo mèimei , tǎ wéi dītóu kàn zhǐ , cái fāxiàn zhè zhāng yǐjīng búshì dìtú le .
pairs.english: When she went into the dining hall to find her sister, Tavi looked down at the paper and realized it was no longer a map.
pairs.hanzi: 等她走进饭厅找妹妹，塔维低头看纸，才发现这张已经不是地图了。

pairs.target: wǔhòu rén duō qǐlái , yīwén bèi jǐgè rén wéizhù , jiěshì wèishénme liǎngzhāng tú de hé wān bù yíyàng : dà tú wèi biāo dàolù , shěng le xiǎo wān , xiǎo tú shì zuòchuán shí jì de , yě méiyǒu liáng zhǔn .
pairs.english: The crowd grew in the afternoon. Surrounded by several people, Iven explained why the river bends differed between the maps: the large one simplified small bends to mark roads; the sketch was recorded from a boat and was not precisely measured either.
pairs.hanzi: 午后人多起来，伊文被几个人围住，解释为什么两张图的河弯不一样：大图为标道路，省了小弯，小图是坐船时记的，也没有量准。

pairs.target: yǒurén tīng wán diǎntóu , yǒurén wèn , nà jiūjìng kàn nǎ zhāng .
pairs.english: Some nodded after listening; others asked which map they were actually supposed to use.
pairs.hanzi: 有人听完点头，有人问，那究竟看哪张。

pairs.target: yīwén shuō ruò yào zǒu lùlù zhǎo huànchē diǎn , kàn shàngmiàn ; ruòxiǎng zhīdào xiàmiàn yě yǒurén guòrìzi , kěyǐ wǎng xià kànkàn . zhēn yào zìjǐ xíngchuán , zhè liǎngzhāng dōu bùnéng yòng .
pairs.english: Iven said to use the upper map for land cart changes; to know that people lived down below too, look lower. For navigating a boat themselves, neither map would do.
pairs.hanzi: 伊文说若要走陆路找换车点，看上面；若想知道下面也有人过日子，可以往下看看。真要自己行船，这两张都不能用。

pairs.target: wén qí zhàn zài lángzhù biān , tīngjiàn le , méiyǒu tì tā huídá . děng rén sàn qù , tā cái shuō zhèngtí quèshí tài dī , yào wǎng shàngyí yìdiǎn , xiàmiàn de zì què búbì quán shān .
pairs.english: Wenqi heard from beside a corridor pillar without answering for him. Once the visitors dispersed, he said the main title really was too low and should move up a little, but the text below need not all be deleted.
pairs.hanzi: 闻祁站在廊柱边，听见了，没有替他回答。等人散去，他才说正题确实太低，要往上移一点，下面的字却不必全删。

pairs.target: " wǒ méi shuō quán shān . " tā yòu bǔ le yíjù .
pairs.english: “I did not say delete it all,” he added.
pairs.hanzi: “我没说全删。”他又补了一句。

pairs.target: yīwén cā le cā zhān mò de zhǐ cè , shuō zìjǐ yě jìbùqīng gāngcái dàodǐ chǎo dào le nǎ yìháng .
pairs.english: Iven rubbed the ink-stained side of his finger and said he could no longer remember exactly which line they had been arguing about.
pairs.hanzi: 伊文擦了擦沾墨的指侧，说自己也记不清刚才到底吵到了哪一行。

pairs.target: liǎnggè rén chóngxīn liáng guàshéng , shuí dōu bùkěn chéngrèn shì zìjǐ xiān liáng cuò , zuìhòu yìqǐ bǎ dèngzǐ bānzǒu le .
pairs.english: They measured the hanging cord again, neither willing to admit having measured wrong first, then carried the stool away together.
pairs.hanzi: 两个人重新量挂绳，谁都不肯承认是自己先量错，最后一起把凳子搬走了。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi chènkōng qù kàn mǐlā . tā hé sū yǐ de liǎngzhī xiǎohé méiyǒu bǎizài zhǎn zhuōshàng , zhǐyǒu yìzhāng huà zhe kuān yè de zhǐ . zhuōbiān fàng zhe yònglái yǎnshì de xiǎo shuǐcáo , shuǐ zǎo dǎokōng le .
pairs.english: Tavi used a free moment to visit Mira. Her and Suyi’s two small boxes were absent from the display table; there was only a sheet showing a broad leaf. The demonstration trough beside it had long since been emptied.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维趁空去看米拉。她和苏苡的两只小盒没有摆在展桌上，只有一张画着宽叶的纸。桌边放着用来演示的小水槽，水早倒空了。

pairs.target: " dǔ le ? " tā wèn . " dìèrbiàn . " mǐlā shuō , " dìyībiàn guò dé hǎo , dìèrbiàn yèbǐng héng le . zǒng bùnéng tiāo yípiàn tīnghuà de gěi rén kàn . "
pairs.english: “Blocked?” he asked. “The second run,” Mira said. “The first went well; the second time the leaf stalk turned crosswise. We cannot just choose an obedient leaf to show people.”
pairs.hanzi:
“堵了？”他问。
“第二遍。”米拉说，“第一遍过得好，第二遍叶柄横了。总不能挑一片听话的给人看。”

pairs.target: sū yǐ zài pángbiān gěi shī mùbǎn cā shuǐ , shuō yǒurén tíyì jiā yíkuài dǎobǎn , tāmen dé huíqù shì , jīntiān bú zuò .
pairs.english: Suyi wiped the wet board beside her and said someone had suggested a guide plate; they would have to test it back at work, not today.
pairs.hanzi: 苏苡在旁边给湿木板擦水，说有人提议加一块导板，她们得回去试，今天不做。

pairs.target: luò hēng lái guò , liúxià zìjǐ de shì cáo chǐcùn , mǐlā bǎ nà zhāng zhǐjiá zài zuì shàngmiàn , zànshí hái méi juédìng yào buyào jiè .
pairs.english: Lohen had visited and left the dimensions of his test trough; Mira clipped that sheet on top and had not yet decided whether to borrow it.
pairs.hanzi: 洛亨来过，留下自己的试槽尺寸，米拉把那张纸夹在最上面，暂时还没决定要不要借。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi gěi tāmen kàn xīn huà de qiǎn pén . mǐlā tīng wán láilì , wèn zhèhuí néng bunéng rènchū shì pén .
pairs.english: Tavi showed them the newly drawn shallow basin. After hearing its story, Mira asked whether this time it could be recognized as a basin.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维给她们看新画的浅盆。米拉听完来历，问这回能不能认出是盆。

pairs.target: tā shuō zhìshǎo búshì xié , sū yǐ méi tīngdǒng , tā zhǐhǎo bǎ nài lěi nàtiān de xiàohuà yě jiǎng le .
pairs.english: He said at least it was not a shoe. Suyi did not understand, so he had to tell Nerai’s joke from that day too.
pairs.hanzi: 他说至少不是鞋，苏苡没听懂，他只好把奈蕾那天的笑话也讲了。

pairs.target: bàngwǎn shōu dōngxī shí , yīwén guòlái wèn , nà nǚrén huà de zhǐ néng bunéng jiè tā chāo yífèn .
pairs.english: While they packed up at dusk, Iven came to ask whether he could borrow the woman’s drawing to copy it.
pairs.hanzi: 傍晚收东西时，伊文过来问，那女人画的纸能不能借他抄一份。

pairs.target: tā xiǎng zài xiàmiàn kòngbáichù tiān yíjù shuōmíng : zhè búshì hédào shàng de dōngxī , shì zhàn zài dìtú qián de rén jiǎng de .
pairs.english: He wanted to add a caption in the blank below: this was not something on the river, but something told by a person standing in front of the map.
pairs.hanzi: 他想在下面空白处添一句说明：这不是河道上的东西，是站在地图前的人讲的。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi jiāng zhǐ dìgěi tā . ménwài láikè jiànjiàn shǎo le , lǐmiàn háiyǒu rén wèn háizi shénme shíhòu chīfàn .
pairs.english: Tavi handed him the paper. Visitors outside gradually thinned, while inside someone was still asking when the children ate.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维将纸递给他。门外来客渐渐少了，里面还有人问孩子什么时候吃饭。

pairs.target: mǐlā duān zhe liǎngzhī kōnghé cóng tāmen zhōngjiān jǐ guò , jiào shuíyǒukōng bāng tā ná zhǐ , bié zhǐgù zhe kàn .
pairs.english: Mira squeezed between them carrying two empty boxes and called for anyone free to take her papers instead of just watching.
pairs.hanzi: 米拉端着两只空盒从他们中间挤过，叫谁有空帮她拿纸，别只顾着看。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi gǎnjǐn jiē zhù . nà zhāng kuān yè de huà bèi fēngchuī qǐ , pū dào tā liǎnshàng , tā tīngjiàn yīwén xiào , gé zhe zhǐ yě xiào qǐlái .
pairs.english: Tavi hurried to take them. The broad-leaf drawing blew up against his face; hearing Iven laugh, he laughed too from behind the paper.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维赶紧接住。那张宽叶的画被风吹起，扑到他脸上，他听见伊文笑，隔着纸也笑起来。
